title: Had Claude generate a trailer for www.simCFB.com
author: SimCFB
selftext:
I had claude do this entirely on it's own. Didn't have to do anything at all. I told it to play the game in the background. Even added music to it. 

The quality is so so. But considering this required almost no effort from me. It's pretty damn good. 

This was the exact prompt (Claude code with Opus 5.5. It already had a ton of context on the game though):  
I need you to build me a 20-30 second tik tok reel for the game. As a promotion. Just tell people to go to [www.simcfb.com](https://www.simcfb.com/) to check it out  
  
Use images from the real game. and add some flashyness to it.  
  
Use the tools at your disposal. Feel free to make some cool 3d objects and animations if you want.
